name: China Next-Gen Commerce and Supply Chain Limited
summary: China Next-Gen Commerce and Supply Chain Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the construction services and property investment business in Singapore. It operates through the Construction Services and Property Investment segments. The company offers civil engineering works, including road, earth, drainage, earth retaining stabilizing structure, and soil improvement works. It also provides building construction works for industrial buildings, such as substructure, piling, addition and alteration, and electrical and mechanical works; and other ancillary services comprising logistics and transportation services of construction materials.
